en.summary: The cache-level flush controller was releasing completion too early; the fix waits for all banks to finish and for the flush requests themselves to issue before returning to idle.
why_it_counts: The patch changes the central cache flush state machine.
It prevents flush completion and request unlocking from happening before the active flush requests have actually drained.
This is a correctness fix to maintenance ordering in the DUT.
evidence: VX_cache_flush.sv no longer clears flush_done when leaving STATE_WAIT; it clears only after all banks are done.
When all banks finish, STATE_FLUSH now enters STATE_DONE, sets lock_released to flush_req_mask, and clears flush_done there.
STATE_DONE waits until the released flush requests are issued before returning to IDLE.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A cache-level maintenance controller must not treat a flush as complete merely because bank-side work has reported done. It must also preserve ordering while the flush request or acknowledgement itself is being released through the request path. If the controller clears completion bookkeeping too early or resumes normal traffic before the outstanding flush requests have actually issued, later accesses can overlap with an incomplete flush sequence.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: cache-level flush completion and request-release ordering
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A flush request is in progress, bank-side flush completion has just been observed, and the controller is about to unlock or forward the flush request back onto the normal request path.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Return to idle immediately after collecting bank-done signals, or release all traffic before the selected flush requests have actually issued.
portability_notes: Map this to a top-level maintenance FSM that blocks ordinary requests during flush.
The fault is in completion bookkeeping and unlock timing, not in bank-local scan logic.
A common manifestation is clearing a done bitmap or lock mask in the wrong state.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the controller state that accumulates per-bank flush completion.
Modify it so completion state is cleared or idle is re-entered as soon as all bank-done bits are seen.
Remove any wait state that keeps ordinary traffic blocked until the released flush requests are actually accepted downstream.
Keep bank-local flush generation unchanged so the regression stays focused on top-level ordering.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cache-level flush FSM around STATE_WAIT, STATE_FLUSH, and STATE_DONE
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix delays clearing flush_done until all banks finish, releases only the active flush requests in STATE_DONE, and waits for those requests to issue before returning to IDLE.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Move flush_done clearing back to the WAIT-to-FLUSH transition and remove the STATE_DONE behavior that selectively releases flush_req_mask and waits for the corresponding requests to issue.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Flush completion can be observed too early, allowing normal requests to interleave with an unfinished flush or allowing the flush acknowledgement path to race ahead of the real maintenance work.
evidence_for_injection: The commit touches only VX_cache_flush.sv, isolating the bug to the cache-level flush controller.
The new STATE_DONE behavior is explicitly about releasing only current flush requests and waiting for them to issue.
flush_done bookkeeping was moved later in the sequence, showing that the previous completion point was premature.
notes: This is a top-level ordering bug, distinct from bank-local scan-completion bugs.
The most portable mutation is to remove the post-bank-completion wait before ordinary traffic is unlocked.

zh.summary: 该 cache 级 flush 控制器原本会过早释放完成；修复要求先等待所有 bank 结束，并且等 flush 请求本身真正发出后，才回到 idle。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了缓存中心的 flush 状态机。
它防止在活动中的 flush 请求真正排空之前就报告 flush 完成并解锁请求。
这是 DUT 中维护性操作顺序的正确性修复。
evidence: VX_cache_flush.sv 不再在离开 STATE_WAIT 时清除 flush_done，而是在所有 bank 完成后才清除。
当所有 bank 结束后，STATE_FLUSH 现在进入 STATE_DONE，设置 lock_released = flush_req_mask，并在此时清空 flush_done。
STATE_DONE 会等待这些已释放的 flush 请求真正发出后，才返回 IDLE。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: cache 级维护控制器不能仅因为 bank 侧报告 done 就把 flush 视为完成。它还必须保证当 flush 请求或 flush 确认通过请求路径释放出去时，维护顺序仍然被保持。如果控制器过早清除完成状态，或者在 flush 请求真正发出前就恢复普通流量，后续访存就可能与未完成的 flush 流程重叠。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: cache 级 flush 完成判定与请求释放顺序
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: flush 请求正在进行，bank 侧 flush 完成刚刚被观测到，控制器准备把 flush 请求重新释放到正常请求路径上。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在收齐 bank-done 信号后立即回到 idle，或者在选中的 flush 请求真正发出前就提前释放所有流量。
portability_notes: 把该故障映射到在 flush 期间会阻塞普通请求的顶层维护状态机。
故障位于完成状态管理和解锁时机，而不在 bank 本地扫描逻辑。
常见体现是 done 位图或 lock mask 在错误的状态下被清除。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位累计各 bank flush 完成状态的控制器状态。
修改它，使控制器在看见全部 bank-done 位后立刻清除完成状态或回到 idle。
删除那些会继续阻塞普通流量、直到已释放 flush 请求真正被下游接受的等待状态。
保持 bank 本地 flush 生成逻辑不变，使回归故障集中在顶层顺序控制。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cache 级 flush FSM 中的 STATE_WAIT、STATE_FLUSH 与 STATE_DONE
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 flush_done 的清零延后到所有 bank 结束之后，在 STATE_DONE 中只释放当前 flush 请求，并等待这些请求真正发出后才返回 IDLE。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 flush_done 的清零移回 WAIT 到 FLUSH 的转移处，并删除 STATE_DONE 中按 flush_req_mask 选择性释放且等待对应请求发出的行为。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 可能过早观察到 flush 完成，从而让普通请求与未完成的 flush 交错，或者让 flush 的确认路径先于真实维护工作完成。
evidence_for_injection: 该提交只修改了 VX_cache_flush.sv，说明故障位于 cache 级 flush 控制器。
新增的 STATE_DONE 行为明确是为了只释放当前 flush 请求并等待它们真正发出。
flush_done 的维护被后移，表明旧的完成点过早。
notes: 这是顶层顺序控制错误，与 bank 本地扫描完成错误不同。
最可迁移的注入方式，是去掉 bank 完成后、普通流量解锁前的那段额外等待。
